# Canonical Data Gap Audit

Capability ID: datafoundry-data-gap-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/datafoundry-data-gap-audit-machine-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- audit this dataset for gaps
- what data is missing for this decision
- find provenance problems in this data
- reconcile conflicting sources
- where are our visibility gaps
- design a plan to close these data gaps

## Problem

A team has a dataset or decision problem and needs to know what is missing, conflicted, stale, inaccessible or governance-restricted before trusting analysis built on top of it.

## Inputs

Authorized dataset/domain plus decision question; optional geography, population scope, metric/subject and source refs.

## Outputs

Explicit gaps and types, severity, evidence/confidence, affected decisions, source conflicts, collection options/effort, governance constraints and next actions.

## Pricing

No approved fixed machine price/payment path verified. Raven data-product concepts are hypotheses unless separately approved.

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

Read-only audit within authorized dataset scope. Any collection project, partner request, records linkage or publication is a separate gated action.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this specific audit.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
